name: turboindex
description: Fully local semantic code search for your AI assistant. Powered by Google TurboQuant vector quantization and jina-v2-base-code embeddings (768-dim, 8K context, 30+ languages). One-command install, zero config, zero cloud. npm install -g turboindex

scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:py && npm run test:js && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff check src/ tests/ benchmarks/
scripts.lint:format: node scripts/run-python.js -m ruff format --check src/ tests/ benchmarks/
